_doc: Item 199 Slice CD - operator-tunable per-bot+sup laning tips. Keyed by '<bot>:<sup>' using DDragon names (case-sensitive, no punctuation per id_map). The default field fires when a pair isn't covered. Tips are 1-2 sentences for the operator's at-a-glance read while both teammates lock in.
default: Coordinate engages with vision. Track jungler timings. Trade respects passive cooldowns.

pairs.Jinx:Senna: Stack souls early for late-game scaling. Senna's range covers Jinx's weak laning.
pairs.Caitlyn:Lux: All-in level 2 with E + W root combo. Push hard for early plates and bot dive setups.
pairs.Kaisa:Rakan: Wait for Rakan W engage to all-in. Save Kaisa E + R for follow-up dives.
pairs.Smolder:TahmKench: Tahm save covers Smolder's stack-farming hesitation. Stay back, scale, win late.
pairs.Smolder:Thresh: Thresh lantern enables aggressive stack farming. Don't waste flash unless Smolder confirms.
pairs.Xayah:Rakan: Xayah R + Rakan W is a level-6 wombo. Trade short, save spells for the engage timing.
pairs.Smolder:Leona: Leona engage forces Smolder into the fight; level-3 all-in works but respect early sustain matchups.
pairs.Ashe:Braum: Braum stacks proc Ashe slows for Concussive Blows. Bully short trades level 1-3.
pairs.MissFortune:Brand: MF Q + Brand stun = level-3 cooldown kill. Stack Brand passive before bursting.
pairs.Jhin:Brand: Brand stun chains into Jhin W root. Look for level-3 all-in with cd-matched W timings.
pairs.Sivir:Braum: Sivir spellshield covers Braum lane-leave fights. Trade after Braum proc passive.
pairs.Caitlyn:Morgana: Morgana W zone forces enemies into Caitlyn traps. Save Q shield for high-CC enemy bots.
pairs.Zeri:Lulu: Lulu shields Zeri's all-in dashes. Don't over-extend without R - Zeri is squishy mid-game.
pairs.Nilah:Yuumi: Nilah pulls Yuumi healing into AoE; bully short trades but respect enemy disengage like Janna.
pairs.Lucian:Yuumi: Lucian double-Q with Yuumi heals enables aggressive level-2 trades. Don't let Yuumi detach early.
pairs.Draven:Blitzcrank: Blitz hook = instant double; if hook misses, Draven backs out. Don't push past river.
pairs.Kalista:Taric: Kalista R + Taric ult = invulnerable engage. Save the combo for objective fights.
pairs.Twitch:Pyke: Twitch invis + Pyke roam = bot freeze + map pressure. Don't fight 2v2 - look mid.
pairs.Senna:Tahm Kench: Stack souls 0-15min, Tahm zone-controls; late-game Senna 1v1s the enemy ADC.
pairs.Yunara:Sona: Sona heal sustains Yunara's poke. Trade with Q + auto-cancels; respect enemy hook champions.
